name: layout
title: Grid
description: Layout primitives: Stack and Row for gaps in one direction, Grid for a set of cards — auto-fitting equals by default, or `columnCount={12}` with `GridItem` spans when the set is deliberately unequal. `gap` is a token step, never a raw px.
